label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from HttpServletRequest.getParameter() flows directly to response.getWriter().println() without any HTML entity encoding or sanitization. Both Thing1 and Thing2 helper classes pass user input through without neutralizing XSS payloads. Setting X-XSS-Protection=0 explicitly disables browser-level XSS defenses.

evidence.note: User parameter retrieved via getTheParameter() and passed to doSomething()
Unsanitized bar variable written directly to response body via println(toCharArray())
